concept: Batch processing in S3: Glue (serverless Spark) + Athena
tests: Distinguishing batch from streaming processing and choosing serverless tools for nightly aggregation of terabytes of logs in S3.
expected: AWS Glue (serverless Spark) for transformation + Athena to query the results. Triggers: "once a night", "terabytes already in S3", "latency not critical", "minimal cluster management", "cost-effective".
why_not: Kinesis + Lambda is for unbounded real-time streams, not reprocessing history; DynamoDB scans over TBs are expensive and slow; a single EC2 with cron does not scale and requires server management.
